description: This script provides functions related to firmware upgrade and management for Linksys devices, including identifying target firmware, performing upgrades, managing boot partitions, and verifying images.

methods.name: linksys_get_target_firmware
methods.description: Determines the target firmware partition for upgrade based on current environment and UBI settings.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process for Linksys devices, handling different image types and updating relevant UBI volumes.

methods.name: linksys_get_cmdline_rootfs_device
methods.description: Extracts the root filesystem device from the kernel command line.

methods.name: linksys_get_current_boot_part_emmc
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition when booting from eMMC, based on environment variables and kernel command line.

methods.name: linksys_set_target_partitions_emmc
methods.description: Sets the target boot and root partitions on eMMC based on current boot state.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_linksys_emmc
methods.description: Handles the upgrade process specifically for devices using eMMC storage.

methods.name: linksys_is_factory_image
methods.description: Verifies if the provided firmware image matches the device's factory signature.
